verdict.rationale: Flagsmith's docs describe end-to-end A/B testing: multivariate flags with percentage-weighted A/B/n variants serve the variations, app events are collected into a managed data warehouse, and a built-in Bayesian statistics engine reads the results. The GitHub README also advertises A/B and multivariate tests on segments. Missing for 10: detailed documentation of metric definition and the winner/results UI, and independent or hands-on corroboration of the experimentation product.
